arxiv-2106-09556.title: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach towards Pendulum Swing-up Problem based on TF-Agents
arxiv-2106-09556.creator: Yifei Bi, Xinyi Chen, Caihui Xiao
arxiv-2106-09556.description: Abstract Adapting the idea of training CartPole with Deep Q-learning agent, we are able to find a promising result that prevent the pole from falling down. The capacity of reinforcement learning (RL) to learn from the interaction between the environment and agent provides an optimal control strategy.

arxiv-2111-01930.title: Deep learning for identification and face, gender, expression recognition under constraints
arxiv-2111-01930.description: Abstract Biometric recognition based on the full face is an extensive research area. However, using only partially visible faces, such as in the case of veiled-persons, is a challenging task. Deep convolutional neural network (CNN) is used in this work to extract the features from veiled-person face images.

arxiv-2201-06409.title: Search and Score-based Waterfall Auction Optimization
arxiv-2201-06409.creator: Dan Halbersberg, Matan Halevi, Moshe Salhov
arxiv-2201-06409.description: Abstract Online advertising is a major source of income for many online companies. One common approach is to sell online advertisements via waterfall auctions, through which a publisher makes sequential price offers to ad networks. The publisher controls the order and prices of the waterfall in an attempt to maximize his revenue.

arxiv-2309-14124.title: Emergence of hydrodynamics in expanding relativistic plasmas Thanks: Presented at Excited QCD 2022, Sicily, Italy, 23-29 October, 2022.
arxiv-2309-14124.creator: Jean-Paul Blaizot
arxiv-2309-14124.description: Abstract I consider a simple set of equations that govern the expansion of boost-invariant plasmas of massless particles. These equations describe the transition from a collisionless regime at early time to hydrodynamics at late time. Their mathematical structure encompasses all versions of second order hydrodynamics.

arxiv-2311-08210.title: Thermodynamics of the S = 1 / 2 S=1/2 hyperkagome-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet
arxiv-2311-08210.creator: Taras Hutak, Taras Krokhmalskii, Jürgen Schnack, Johannes Richter, Oleg Derzhko
arxiv-2311-08210.description: Abstract The S = 1 / 2 S=1/2 hyperkagome-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet allows to study the interplay of geometrical frustration and quantum as well as thermal fluctuations in three dimensions. We use 16 terms of a high-temperature series expansion complemented by the entropy-method interpolation to examine the specific heat and the uniform susceptibility of this model.

arxiv-2404-01568.title: A Linear Time and Space Local Point Cloud Geometry Encoder via Vectorized Kernel Mixture (VecKM)
arxiv-2404-01568.creator: Dehao Yuan, Cornelia Fermüller, Tahseen Rabbani, Furong Huang, Yiannis Aloimonos
arxiv-2404-01568.description: Abstract We propose VecKM, a local point cloud geometry encoder that is descriptive and efficient to compute. VecKM leverages a unique approach by vectorizing a kernel mixture to represent the local point cloud. Such representation’s descriptiveness is supported by two theorems that validate its ability to reconstruct and preserve the similarity of the local shape.

arxiv-2501-02091.title: PriveShield: Enhancing User Privacy Using Automatic Isolated Profiles in Browsers Thanks: * Corresponding Author, sadatakhavani.s@northeastern.edu , Northeastern University, Boston, MA Thanks: ** ek@ccs.neu.edu , Northeastern University, Boston, MA Thanks: *** mkharraz@fiu.edu , Florida Internationa
arxiv-2501-02091.creator: Seyed Ali Akhavani*, Engin Kirda**, Amin Kharraz***
arxiv-2501-02091.description: Abstract Online tracking is a widespread practice on the web with questionable ethics, security, and privacy concerns. While web tracking can offer personalized and curated content to Internet users, it operates as a sophisticated surveillance mechanism to gather extensive user information.

arxiv-2503-01885.title: Learning Policy Committees for Effective Personalization in MDPs with Diverse Tasks
arxiv-2503-01885.creator: Luise Ge, Michael Lanier, Anindya Sarkar, Bengisu Guresti, Chongjie Zhang, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik
arxiv-2503-01885.description: Abstract Many dynamic decision problems, such as robotic control, involve a series of tasks, many of which are unknown at training time. Typical approaches for these problems, such as multi-task and meta-reinforcement learning, do not generalize well when the tasks are diverse.

arxiv-2503-20013.title: Comparison of magnetic diffusion and reconnection in ideal and resistive relativistic magnetohydrodynamics, ideal magnetodynamics, and resistive force-free electrodynamics
arxiv-2503-20013.creator: Michael P. Grehan, Tanisha Ghosal, James R. Beattie, Bart Ripperda, Oliver Porth, Fabio Bacchini
arxiv-2503-20013.description: Abstract High-energy astrophysical systems and compact objects are frequently modeled using ideal relativistic magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) or force-free electrodynamic (FFE) simulations, with the underlying assumption that the discretisation from the numerical scheme introduces an effective (numerical) magnetic resistivity that adequately resembles an explicit resistivity.

pmc-10716147.title: Effect of Pd/Pt decoration on MoSSe monolayer for CH4 signature through surface adsorption mechanism
pmc-10716147.creator: Bindiya Babariya, Sanjeev K Gupta, P N Gajjar
pmc-10716147.description: Considering the current breakthrough in gas sensor technology, we have examined impact of CH4 in the vicinity of pristine MoSSe and Pd/Pt decorated MoSSe monolayers using first principles approach. The negative formation energies confirm structural stability of considered monolayers. The pristine MoSSe monolayer is semiconductor having 1.52 eV direct band gap. This value decreases in the presence of Pd/Pt adatom.

pmc-11301832.title: Management and outcome of intracranial fungal infections in children and adults in Africa: a scoping review
pmc-11301832.creator: Berjo Dongmo Takoutsing, Setthasorn Zhi Yang Ooi, Chinedu Egu, Conor S Gillespie, David Ulrich Dalle, Joshua Erhabor, Ana Catinca Ciuculete, Özgür Kesici, Ahmed K Awad, Yao Christian Hugues Dokponou, Mehdi Khan, Chibuikem A Ikwuegbuenyi, Olaoluwa Ezekiel Dada, Soham Bandyopadhyay, Nourou Dine Adenir
pmc-11301832.description: IntroductionIntracranial fungal infections’ (IcFIs) varying clinical manifestations lead to difficulties in diagnosis and treatment. African populations are disproportionately affected by the high burden of the disease. There is a lack of clarity as to the diagnostic and treatment modalities employed across the continent. In this review, we aim to detail the management, and outcome of IcFIs across Africa.

pmc-11452994.title: Comprehensive molecular and clinical findings in 29 patients with multi-locus imprinting disturbance
pmc-11452994.creator: Tatsuki Urakawa, Hidenobu Soejima, Kaori Yamoto, Kaori Hara-Isono, Akie Nakamura, Sayaka Kawashima, Hiromune Narusawa, Rika Kosaki, Yutaka Nishimura, Kazuki Yamazawa, Tetsuo Hattori, Yukako Muramatsu, Takanobu Inoue, Keiko Matsubara, Maki Fukami, Shinji Saitoh, Tsutomu Ogata, Masayo Kagami
pmc-11452994.description: BackgroundMulti-locus imprinting disturbance (MLID) with methylation defects in various differentially methylated regions (DMRs) has recently been identified in approximately 150 cases with imprinting disorders (IDs), and deleterious variants have been found in genes related to methylation maintenance of DMRs, such as those encoding proteins constructing the subcortical maternal complex (SCMC), in a small fraction of patients and/or their mothers.

pmc-11670848.title: Evaluation of risk factors for childhood myopia progression: A systematic review of the literature
pmc-11670848.creator: Chun-Wen Chen, Jing-Yan Yao
pmc-11670848.description: Myopia is a global public issue with a dramatically increasing incidence. Myopia is currently characterized by its earlier onset, quick development in preschool (0–5 years old), and continued progression particularly during the coronavirus-19 epidemic phase. It has been established that myopia experienced during childhood earlier resulted in vision impairment.

pmc-11731930.title: Finding the new potential research on diabetic kidney disease and hemodialysis in healthcare insurance databases: A bibliometric analysis
pmc-11731930.creator: Lily Kresnowati, Suhartono Suhartono, Zahroh Shaluhiyah, Bagoes Widjanarko
pmc-11731930.description: To the best of our knowledge, bibliometric analysis has not been performed for studies related to diabetic kidney disease (DKD) and hemodialysis using healthcare big data. Herein, the aim of this bibliometric analysis was to identify emerging research trends in DKD and hemodialysis within healthcare insurance databases by exploring authors, co-author networks, and countries to discover new potential research areas.

pmc-12431095.title: Optimized Sensor Data Preprocessing Using Parameter-Transfer Learning for Wind Turbine Power Curve Modeling
pmc-12431095.creator: Pedro Martín-Calzada, Pedro Martín Sánchez, Francisco Javier Rodríguez-Sánchez, Carlos Santos-Pérez, Jorge Ballesteros, Marco Carratù, Gabriele Patrizi
pmc-12431095.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Wind turbine power curve modeling is essential for wind power forecasting, turbine performance monitoring, and predictive maintenance. However, SCADA data often contain anomalies (e.g., curtailment, sensor faults), degrading the accuracy of power curve predictions. This paper presents a parameter-transfer learning strategy within a preprocessing and modeling framework that jointly optimizes anomaly detection (iForest, LOF, DBSCAN) and WTPC regressors (MLP, RF, GP) via a multi-metric objective adaptable to specific modeling requirements.

pmc-12452962.title: Iron-Oxide Labeled Stem Cells with Specific Magnetic Occurrence for Effective in Mouse Model of Cisplatin-Induced Acute Kidney Injury
pmc-12452962.creator: Ke Wang, Ye Zhao, Huiying Lv, Xiuying Li
pmc-12452962.description: BackgroundAcute kidney injury (AKI) is characterized by the abrupt loss of renal function and lack of curative therapies. Placental-derived mesenchymal stem cells (PL-MSCs) have shown promise in regenerative medicine, including in the treatment of AKI. However, optimizing the therapeutic effects of PL-MSCs remains a critical objective. Magnetic targeting is one potential avenue of optimization.

pmc-12855879.title: Lymphatic–stem cell crosstalk promotes tendon regeneration via Notch1–Srebp2–mediated cholesterol metabolism
pmc-12855879.creator: Liujing Chen, Meilian Cai, Shuai Lin, Mingzhao Li, Zilu Zhu, Han Zhang, Hu Zhao, Chun Xu, Ruili Yang
pmc-12855879.description: Tendons, as bradytrophic tissues, exhibit limited healing capacity. The role of lymphatic vessels in tendon regeneration is largely overlooked. By comparing gene expression of the control and injured tendon cells from both neonatal and adult mice, we identify lymphatic vessels as key regenerative niche elements.

pmc-13053973.title: MSA2-Net: Utilizing self-adaptive convolution module to extract multi-scale information in medical image segmentation
pmc-13053973.creator: Xiao Qin, Chao Deng, Xiaosen Li, Zhengyou Qin, Yuanxu Gong
pmc-13053973.description: The nnU-Net framework effectively automates hyperparameter selection; however, its fixed internal configurations—notably convolution kernel sizes—restrict its flexibility. This limitation is pronounced in 3D medical imaging, where anatomical structures undergo continuous spatial evolution along the Z-axis. In this study, we introduce a self-adaptive convolution module designed to dynamically tune the effective receptive field, matching the dynamic structural transformations of organs.
